sample_rule: Hybrid-8 if n <= 32; else runs_count if sampled local descent permille <= 125; else Hybrid-8
length_rule: Hybrid-8 if n <= 32; else runs_count (length only, no sampled features)
primary_metric: sum of per-input median end-to-end ns versus training-selected best fixed, then paired ratio distribution
snapshot_selection: for each training size and model kind, minimum validation E2E sum; lexicographic hyperparameter tie break
final_selection: largest training size only; hyperparameters chosen on the same validation set; separate classifier and cost-ranking models
failure_policy: retain status and null metrics; never zero-impute; any missing main-stage response blocks complete-case headline and final acceptance
backend: same lean --run direct executor for every candidate and deployed policy; no interpreter timing labels
old_data_policy: do not train on historical timings; old inputs are development-only and excluded by hash from final data
